# device42_auto_discovery_portscan (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_portscan" "example" {
  name          = "portscan"
  server        = "hostname.domain.local"
  start_ip      = "10.0.0.1"
  schedule_days = "0,1,2,3,4"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the portscan autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.

### Optional

- `capture_hosts_file` (String) Whether to capture the hosts file.
- `discover_cluster` (String) Whether to discover clusters.
- `end_ip` (String) End of the IP address range.
- `overwrite_device_categories` (String) Whether to overwrite the device categories of existing devices.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `start_ip` (String) Start of the IP address range.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
